sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Augmented Aim is a Pictos in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33. Effect: 50% increased Free Aim damage.

sections.title: How to Get Augmented Aim
sections.content: Location: Flying Waters - Noco's Hut, climb the anchor.

sections.title: Is It Worth Equipping?
sections.content: Pictos unlock a Lumina after four battles, so equipping it once is enough to keep the effect permanently available for the Lumina cost.
